Experience in a medical office or hospital environment

Answers the telephone professionally and courteously within defined time. Projects a professional and pleasant voice in all telephone communications. Manages multiple calls while minimizing the time callers are on hold. Efficiently and accurately meets the needs of callers requesting information about procedures or reports performed within the department. Assists the radiologist, and physicians as needed in a professional and pleasant manner. Works closely with the registration department in processing outpatients through the department.

Routinely utilized the Meditech computer scheduling module to schedule procedures in multiple departments within imaging. Verifies clinical history with the requested exam then enters orders into the order entry system accurately.

Provides imaging interpretation reports and films upon request of the referring physicians and files films. Ensure timely distribution of reports to physicians nursing units or MIS via fax, courier mail, or volunteers.

Establishes and maintains the patient records to comply with regulatory and legal requirements. Ensure prompt distribution and filing of reports and films. Maintains the 7-day file and long-term files. Purge reading room films daily.

Assists in the monitoring of clerical/file process, recommending modifications for improvement. Represents the department as a super user for the Meditech computer information system. Inputs data and tests the functionality of the radiology and scheduling modules during all revisions and upgrades to Meditech. Updates the dictionaries within the radiology and scheduling modules.

Maintains the Meditech radiology and scheduling modules. Troubleshoots and corrects problems identified within the modules or is a resource to Meditech in resolving issues identified. Maintains communications with other Meditech users at other facilities to optimize functionality and problem solving with the system. Trains and assists various staff members in the operation of the computer system.
Customer service skills in telephone communications
